name: everruns
description: Use Everruns from your coding agent: hand tasks to your agents, build and test new ones, debug and evaluate them, ship them to Slack, the web and other channels, and keep an eye on cost and health.

interface.shortDescription: Run, build, debug, evaluate and ship Everruns agents.
interface.longDescription: Use Everruns from Codex to hand tasks to your agents, create and change agents, debug and evaluate them, keep agent definitions as files in your repository, publish agents to Slack, the web, A2A and other channels, and check spend and health. Signs in to Everruns Cloud with OAuth.
defaultPrompt: Create an Everruns agent that summarizes Hacker News every morning, run it once, and show me the result.
